kernel_planes.role: Host runtime, tools and system capabilities observed in the actual environment
kernel_planes.non_implication: Requested or named capability is not installed or active capability

kernel_planes.role: RepoKernel-generated semantic identity, continuity and meta-faculty of this project
kernel_planes.non_implication: Generated contract is not host discovery or external authority

kernel_planes.role: MAIOS decoder, state bridge, crystallization and host-entry composition
kernel_planes.non_implication: Product composition does not replace the generated Project Kernel

kernel_planes.role: Source-bound operating faculty for a situated project capability or task
kernel_planes.non_implication: A candidate file is not an accepted, discovered or maintained competence

delta_contract.acceptance_rule: Only the project owner or the named capability owner can accept a delta; the producing assistant cannot self-approve it
delta_contract.retention_rule: Keep only a delta that changes future behavior, proof, recovery or reentry

delta_kinds.use_when: One-case accepted fact, decision, responsibility or current movement changes
A reviewed correction changes future reentry, recovery or source interpretation
Repeated situated ability changes how an existing project competence behaves
delta_kinds.target: reviewed competence version and its evidence

delta_kinds.use_when: A repeatable bounded method with trigger, inputs, output and falsifiable test is missing after composition
A stable deterministic transformation should be executable and tested independently
delta_kinds.target: project-native code or function contract after owner review

delta_kinds.use_when: A source-bound invariant changes how multiple faculties are recognized, composed, validated or evolved
delta_kinds.target: project-local candidate first; every wider projection requires its own owner gate

completion: facts hypotheses and unknowns remain distinct
learning is placed at the smallest truthful delta kind
candidate acceptance and effect authority are not inferred
fresh reentry can recover the reviewed movement without transcript dependence
